note: Understand eval cases for the design review stage. The repository has no Understand eval runner yet (tests/eval holds tool-calling cases only), so these are fixtures: each case is a request and the reading a correct Understand answer must contain in its `design` field. tests/contract/design-review-mode.test.ts checks that every expected reading is accepted by the intent reader and resolves to the expected ON/OFF under the auto setting. A live-model run can use `request` as the prompt and compare `expect` to the model's `design` field.
